items: Islands from phase 1 have lakes: a few areas of water, never by home, with small shores where the forest floor runs down into the water (no beaches)
Lake water is a lighter blue than the sea, with the stars and the moon in it, and some lakes have koi
You can fly over a lake in the treetops but can't land on it; on foot you stop at the shore, and so do the animals, who walk round
